replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a distant cousin I respect but rarely visit. My favorite subjects are literature and physics, so math often seems abstract and disconnected from my interests. While I appreciate its logic, it doesn't spark the same curiosity as exploring stories or understanding physical phenomena.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. With high neuroticism scores, complex numbers trigger immediate worry. I fear making mistakes or not grasping concepts quickly. This anxiety makes me avoid math-heavy tasks unless I feel completely safe and supported by someone patient.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutor once for physics problems, which felt helpful. However, when it came to math, I found the explanations too technical and rushed. It didn't account for my anxiety or need for reassurance, so I stopped using it after a few frustrating sessions.
